figures.caption: Submittals turn specified products and assemblies into reviewable information before they are ordered or installed, helping the team confirm that the intended materials fit the project.

figures.alt: Contractor qualification documents, insurance verification, and a blank checklist organized on a clean desk
figures.caption: A dependable workflow records who prepares, reviews, returns, revises, approves, releases, and tracks each item so field work is not built around assumptions.

figures.alt: Residential renovation rough-in inspected with open framing, routed services, and a clean protected work area
figures.caption: Late or incomplete approvals can reach the field as missing information, delayed material, or a detail that conflicts with the installed work. The review cycle is part of construction control.
